svg.title: Desk node on a dot board
svg.text: TOP side - where the parts and the wires go
Solid = on this side. Dashed = on the underside (buses and bent legs), shown so you know where they run. Bodies drawn to scale.
ESP32 on two female headers, USB at the top.
The antenna end reaches ~5 rows below this drawing.
green link: round the top end, over the red and black links
470 ohm standing on (19,10); its top leg slants down into (21,10), sleeved
1000 uF, 10 mm can: LONG leg (19,16) on the +5V bus, striped SHORT leg (21,16)
lash: bare wire through (26,4) and (26,12), over the bundle
UNDERSIDE - turned over left-to-right like a page, so the USB end is still at the top
Column 1 is now on the RIGHT. Find the corner mark first, every time you turn the board over. Dots = solder joints.
corner mark - column 1 is on the RIGHT now
no ESP32 on this side: 30 header pins to solder
link ends: through (16,3) and (16,4), bent onto the VIN and GND pins
(17,8): diode band leg + green link end from (16,8), one joint
junction: diode's plain leg down (21,8)-(21,11), cut past (21,11)
1000 uF short leg from (21,16) to the GND bus at (23,16)
solid dots: soldered at step 2. Rings: soldered when that leg arrives
green link's other end from (4,8), bent onto the RX2 pin
thick red / dark grey: a BUS - one bare wire along the pads on the underside, laid beside the hole centres. Dashed in the top view because it is underneath
thin solid green / red / black (top view): an insulated link on this side; its end goes through the hole NEXT to the pin and is bent onto the pin underneath
amber: the diode's own plain leg, bent along four pads under the board. The 470 ohm and the green DIN wire go through beside it and solder to it
Hole numbers are (column, row) from the corner mark. Only three ESP32 pins are used: VIN, the GND right below VIN, and RX2. Nothing goes to 3V3 or the other GND.
Nothing bare may reach from one bus to the other. Between them there are only three things:
the junction (column 21), the capacitor leg into the GND bus, and the two legs of the 0.1 uF.
